goal: Improve the message rendering aesthetics in the frontend to match top-tier AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Claude, and DeepSeek, reducing the "clustered" feel.

steps.task: Read and analyze current frontend implementation (frontend/ui.js, frontend/style.css, frontend/index.html)
steps.result: Implemented professional markdown rendering styles in frontend/style.css and updated frontend/index.html to include JetBrains Mono font. Improved typography, spacing, code blocks, and bubble aesthetics to match industry standards like ChatGPT and Claude.

steps.task: Research and document markdown rendering patterns used by ChatGPT, Claude, and DeepSeek (typography, spacing, code blocks, lists)
Perform a gap analysis between the current implementation and industry standards
steps.result: Gap analysis performed: Identified that current spacing was too tight (0.6em) and code blocks lacked professional contrast and typography.

steps.task: Implement CSS improvements in frontend/style.css for spacing, typography, and code blocks
Implement JS improvements in frontend/ui.js if required (e.g., marked options, wrapper classes)
steps.result: Verified that current marked.parse implementation in frontend/ui.js works with the new CSS styles. No JS changes were required as CSS targets the generated HTML.

steps.task: Final review and report of changes
